dialog.title: Gdesk ran into a problem
dialog.description: You can report this error. Check the content below before you send it. Folder paths, repository names and your username have been removed.
dialog.sendIssue: Send opens a new issue on GitHub in your browser with this content filled in. Nothing is sent automatically.
dialog.sendCopy: This build has no Gdesk repository set, so Send copies the content to the clipboard.

status.opened: Opened the new issue page in your browser.
status.truncated: Opened the new issue page in your browser. The report was long, so the end was cut off.
status.failed: Couldn't send the report. Copy the content above yourself.

boundary.title: This screen ran into a problem
boundary.message: Try again. You can also report the error from the dialog.
